newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hardie sees lower dividend franking rates.
newsitem.headline: Hardie sees lower dividend franking rates.

text.p: Building products manufacturer James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Thursday it expected a smaller proportion of franking credits to apply to its dividend payments in future years.
Asked at the annual meeting what level of franking shareholders could expect in the future, the company chairman Alan McGregor said: "It will be a small proportion at best."
McGregor said the Australian government's decision in its most recent budget to stop the purchase of franking credits meant the company no longer could buy those credits.
He said the company's level of franking credits would now depend on the amount of Australian tax it paid.

He said the company's strategy of focussing on expanding offshore meant that Australian earnings and tax paid on those earnings would increasingly become a smaller percentage of the company's overall operations.
